If \(a\) and \(b\) are integers and \(a < b\), \(b > 1\) then compare \(\dfrac{a-1}{b-1}\), \(\dfrac{a+1}{b+1}\).
solution:
\(a < b\)  \(\therefore a - 1 < b - 1\)
Now consider the subtraction \(\dfrac{a-1}{b-1} - \dfrac{a+1}{b+1}\).
\(\dfrac{a-1}{b-1} - \dfrac{a+1}{b+1} = \dfrac{(a-1)(b+1) - (a+1)(b-1)}{(b-1)(b+1)}\)
\(= \dfrac{(ab - b + a - 1) - (ab + b - a - 1)}{b^2 - 1}\)
\(= \dfrac{ab - b + a - 1 - ab - b + a + 1}{b^2 - 1}\)
\(= \dfrac{2a - 2b}{b^2 - 1} = \dfrac{2(a-b)}{b^2 - 1}\) .......... (1)
Now \(a < b\)  \(\therefore a - b < 0\); also \(b^2 - 1 > 0\) because \(b > 1\)
\(\therefore \dfrac{2(a-b)}{b^2 - 1} < 0\) .......... (2)
\(\therefore \dfrac{a-1}{b-1} - \dfrac{a+1}{b+1} < 0\) .....from (1) and (2)
\(\therefore \dfrac{a-1}{b-1} < \dfrac{a+1}{b+1}\)

stem: If \(a : b = 2 : 1\) and \(b : c = 4 : 1\) then find the value of \(\left(\dfrac{a^4}{32b^2c^2}\right)^3\).
solution:
\(\dfrac{a}{b} = \dfrac{2}{1}\)  \(\therefore a = 2b\);  \(\dfrac{b}{c} = \dfrac{4}{1}\)  \(\therefore b = 4c\)
\(a = 2b = 2 \times 4c = 8c\)  \(\therefore a = 8c\)
Now substituting the values \(a = 8c\), \(b = 4c\) :
\(\left(\dfrac{a^4}{32b^2c^2}\right)^3 = \left(\dfrac{(8c)^4}{32 \times 4^2 \times c^2 \times c^2}\right)^3\)
\(= \left[\dfrac{8 \times 8 \times 8 \times 8 \times c^4}{32 \times 16 \times c^2 \times c^2}\right]^3\)
\(= (8)^3\)
\(\therefore \left(\dfrac{a^4}{32b^2c^2}\right)^3 = 512\)
